subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored configuration actions in SKILL.md frontmatter, and what URL/action trust contract should the dashboard enforce?
rationale: The implementation path is straightforward, but accepting skill-provided URLs changes public skill metadata and authenticated dashboard trust semantics, which is a product/security boundary decision.

options.title: Approve Typed Config Action
options.body: Add a generic skill configuration action with shared URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

options.title: Keep Existing Link Surfaces
options.body: Do not add new fields now; document `homepage`, Skill Cards, and ClawHub pages as the supported configuration discovery paths.

options.title: Prototype Through ClawHub Or Skill Cards
options.body: Let ClawHub or Skill Card metadata carry configuration links first, then add a core dashboard action only after the trust model settles.

recommendation.title: Approve Typed Config Action
recommendation.body: Add a generic skill configuration action with shared URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current Skills page and the Control UI URL-safety path that recent history routes through shakkernerd.
